Offline-first is not a feature you add later. It decides whether a shop can trade during an outage.

→ Every till keeps a local copy of prices, stock and settings
→ Sales are queued as idempotent commands with client-generated IDs
→ On reconnection the queue drains automatically; the server applies each sale once
→ Sync health per terminal is visible to head office

For operators in markets where connectivity is unreliable: Lebanon first, and anywhere power or networks drop.
